title: Хитрость по дороге в аэропорт  (Trickery on the Way to the Airport)

segments.t: In the dining room, Vika welcomes Ilya back to the waitstaff and tells him to change into his uniform right away. Meanwhile in the kitchen, Chef Barinov answers a call from Elena Pavlovna and pretends he has already arrived at the airport terminal.
Я ведь тоже вроде как больной.
А то тут проверка на входе.
Right, let's take their exchange slowly and unpack the Russian.
'You can start working right today.' Here the Russian phrasing highlights 'to go out' before landing on 'today'.
'Get your uniform and go change.' Vika brings out the contrast between 'take that' and 'uniform' in a few short words.
'Thank you, Viktoriya Sergeyevna.' Spoken Russian keeps this brisk, leaning on 'thank you' and finishing on 'Sergeyevna'. Chef Viktor answers right away.
'Awesome. Thank you.' Chef Viktor brings out the contrast between 'super' and 'thank you' in a few short words.
'How are things going?' Here the Russian phrasing highlights 'how' before landing on 'things'.
'Here we are at the airport already.' Notice how Russian expresses 'there you go' and 'the airport' with crisp inflection rather than helper words. Chef Viktor answers right away.
'You got there awfully fast somehow.' The meaning hinges on 'somehow' working together with 'to reach' in spoken Russian.
'We drove right behind an ambulance.' In Russian, the idea of 'behind' flows naturally into 'help' without extra filler words.
Я ведь тоже вроде как больной.
'After all, I am supposedly a patient too.' Here the Russian phrasing highlights 'I' before landing on 'sick'. Chef Viktor answers right away.
'Chef, keep quiet.' The grammar packs 'chef' and 'shut up' into a tight, idiomatic kitchen exchange.
'I will call you back later.' Spoken Russian keeps this brisk, leaning on 'I' and finishing on 'will call back'.
'Anyway, that is it.' Kostya brings out the contrast between 'short' and 'short' in a few short words. Chef Viktor answers right away.
А то тут проверка на входе.
'There is a security check at the entrance here.' The meaning hinges on 'and' working together with 'entrance' in spoken Russian. Now let's listen to the entire scene again without interruption.
Я ведь тоже вроде как больной.
А то тут проверка на входе.
